say:1:1620777101:1.text: Thank you so much, Magister Merlin!
say:1:1620777101:1.male: Thank you so much, Magister Merlin!
say:1:1620777101:1.female: Thank you so much, Magister Merlin!

say:2:1620777102:1.text: I've found that the flying Hypofiends summoned by chaos magic show patterns in when they appear, when they leave this plane, and how they act.
say:2:1620777102:1.source_cn: 我发现混沌魔法变出的飞行魔物不管是出现与消失的时机，还...
say:2:1620777102:1.male: I've found that the flying Hypofiends summoned by chaos magic show patterns in when they appear, when they leave this plane, and how they act.
say:2:1620777102:1.female: I've found that the flying Hypofiends summoned by chaos magic show patterns in when they appear, when they leave this plane, and how they act.

say:3:1620777103:1.text: Give me a little more time, and I think I'll have an answer.
say:3:1620777103:1.source_cn: 我再研究一会儿应该就有结论了。
say:3:1620777103:1.male: Give me a little more time, and I think I'll have an answer.
say:3:1620777103:1.female: Give me a little more time, and I think I'll have an answer.

narration:4:1620777104:1.text: Over the course of the night, you deal with countless transformed monsters, all sorts of bizarre flying creatures, and explosions big and small... Fortunately, the students emerge completely unharmed.
